Home.howTitle: Files ke dher se bharose ke plan tak
Home.howSubtitle: Neeche ka har step aaj app mein chalu hai.
Home.step1Body: Har exam ya subject ka ek, baaki se bilkul alag.
Home.step2Body: Private storage, scan pages ke liye 4 zabaanon mein OCR.
Home.step3Body: Page aur heading se baanta, taake har quote ka source mile.
Home.step4Body: Naam badlo, kram badlo ya mitao — aapke badlaav rehte.
Home.step5Body: Sirf approve kiye topics pe sawaal aate.
Home.step6Body: Aapki files se 5–15 sawaal, har ek quote ke saath.
Home.featuresTitle: Aisa banaya ki aap har cheez check kar sako
Home.featuresBody: GapFinder apna poora kaam dikhata: har topic kahaan se aaya, kaiku zaroori hai, aur har file ke saath kya hua.
Home.feature1Body: Koi bhi topic kholo aur dekho woh kaunse sahi quote, kaunsi file, kaunse page aur kaunsi heading se aaya. Agar aapki files kisi baat ko support nahi karte, toh GapFinder andaaza lagane ke bajaye saaf bol deta.
Home.feature1Point1: Sahi quotes, aapki file se mila ke check kiye
Home.feature1Point2: Har quote ke liye page aur heading
Home.feature1Point3: Translate kiye quotes pe translation ka label
Home.feature2Body: Aapke purane paperon se sawaal unke marks aur saal ke saath alag kiye jaate, phir aapke approve kiye topics se milaye jaate. Jin topics pe zyaada sawaal aate unki ahmiyat zyaada hoti — aur aap isku kabhi bhi badal sakte.
Home.feature2Point1: Marks aur saal paper se hich padhe jaate
Home.feature3Title: Har file ki processing pe nazar rakho
Home.feature3Body: Dekho har upload check, padhai aur indexing se kaisa guzarta. Agar koi file padhi nahi jaa sakti, toh saaf wajah aur ek click mein dobara koshish milti.
Home.feature3Point1: Har upload checksum se pakka kiya jaata
Home.feature3Point2: Scan kiye PDF ke liye OCR
Home.darkBody: GapFinder aisa banaya ki koi student doosre ka workspace kabhi nahi dekh sakta — yeh app mein aur phir database mein bhi laagu hai.
Home.dark1Body: Har request aapke account aur workspace se check hoti.
Home.dark2Body: Files kabhi public nahi hote; preview aise links se khulte jo ek minute mein khatam ho jaate.
Home.dark3Body: Workspace mitaaye toh uske files, text aur topics sab mit jaate.
Home.dark4Body: AI ka har jawaab aapku dikhne se pehle aapki files se mila ke check hota.
Home.tour1Body: Har exam ku uske apne private workspace mein rakho.
Home.tour2Body: Files upload karo aur unku dhoondne layak source bante dekho.
Home.tour3Body: Syllabus se suggest kiye topics edit karo, jamao aur approve karo.
Home.tour4Body: Check karo har topic theek kahaan se aaya.
Home.tour5Body: Multiple choice, sahi/galat aur chhote jawaab wale sawaal, time ke saath ya bina time.
Home.tour6Body: Sahi jawaab aur usku saabit karne wala sahi hissa dekho.
Home.faq1A: Sab ke liye chalu rakhne ke liye har student ki saaf daily limits hai: 10 jaanch ya re-test, 20 explanations, 10 voice requests aur 10 tasveeraan.
Home.faq2Q: Main kaunsi files upload kar sakta/sakti?
Home.faq2A: Saada text (.txt), Word (.docx) aur PDF — scan kiye PDF bhi, jo OCR se padhe jaate. Har file 50 MB tak ho sakti.
Home.faq3Q: Kya GapFinder internet se jaankaari leta?
Home.faq3A: Nahi. Topics, sawaal, checking aur explanations sirf aapke workspace ki files se, sahi quotes ke saath aate. Jab aapki files kisi baat ka saath nahi deti, GapFinder kami bharne ke bajaaye bata deta.
Home.faq4A: Interface English, Hindi, Punjabi, Telugu aur Dakhni (Latin script) mein hai. Aapka material English, Hindi, Punjabi ya Telugu mein ho sakta; asal quotes hamesha dikhte, aur zaroorat pade toh label wale translation bhi.
Home.faq5A: Sirf aap. Workspaces aapke account tak private hai aur files private rakhe jaate. Workspace delete karne pe uski files aur unse bana sab kuch delete hota, aur aap kabhi bhi poora account delete kar sakte.
Home.ctaBody: Account banao aur shuru karne ke liye apna syllabus upload karo.
Home.step7Body: Har unit Kamzor, Darmiyaan ya Mazboot — reasons aur sources ke saath.
Home.step8Body: Kamzor, zaroori units pehle — time kam ho toh saaf bolta.
Home.step9Body: Har re-test naya report version deta, progress saaf dikhta.
Home.tour7Body: Labels, reasons, ahmiyat aur chhoote sawaal — har ek apne source ke saath.
Home.tour8Body: Aapki report aur available time se din-ba-din sessions, aur koi kami ho toh imaandari se dikhaate.
Home.tour9Body: Report versions mein unit ke hisaab se mastery, chart ya table mein.
Home.step10Body: Type karo ya bolo; jawaab sirf aapki files se, quotes ke saath.
Home.tour10Body: Sources ke saath jawaab, “Suno” button aur AI se bani bataayi hui tasveer.
Home.feature4Title: Aapke apne notes se likhi jaanch
Home.feature4Body: 5, 10 ya 15 sawaal chuno, time ke saath ya bina. MCQ jawaab tay rules se check hote; likhe jawaab chhupe criteria aur aapke sources se check hote — kabhi banaaya hua score nahi.
Home.feature4Point1: Har sawaal kisi sahi quote pe tika
Home.feature4Point2: Autosave, keyboard shortcuts aur server ka timer
Home.feature4Point3: Review mein jawaab, criteria aur source
Home.feature5Title: Sach bolne wali Gap Report aur plan
Home.feature5Body: Units ko public hadon se label milta, kami aur exam ahmiyat se order milta, aur woh din-ba-din sessions mein badalte. Time kam ho toh plan dabaata nahi, saaf bolta.
Home.feature5Point2: Har report aur plan version rakha jaata
Home.feature5Point3: Kamiyon ka re-test karo aur mastery badalti dekho
Home.feature6Body: Kisi bhi topic ke baare mein type karke ya bol ke poocho. Jawaab sirf aapki files se aate aur quotes dikhaate; aap unko sun sakte, aur apni kitaab ki tasveer ya saaf label wali tasveer dekh sakte.
Home.feature6Point1: General knowledge se jawaab nahi — kami saaf bataate
Home.feature6Point2: English, Hindi, Punjabi aur Telugu mein voice
Home.feature6Point3: Tasveeron ko kabhi source nahi maante
Home.faq6Q: Kya bina kuch upload kiye try kar sakte?
Home.faq6A: Haan. Sign up karo aur demo workspace kholo: GapFinder ke liye likhe Class 10 Science ke sample notes, syllabus aur practice paper — jaanch, report, plan aur explanation ke liye tayyaar. Yeh aapke account mein ek private copy hai.
Home.faq7Q: Kya tasveeraan aur voice wale jawaab bharose ke hai?
Home.faq7A: Likha hua jawaab aur uske quotes hi asli bunyaad hai. Voice wohi jawaab padh ke sunaati. Tasveeraan sirf aapke quote kiye sources ki baaton se banti, AI se bani bataayi jaati aur kabhi source nahi maani jaati; aapki PDF mein apni tasveer ho toh GapFinder wohi dikhaata.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: GapFinder AI students ke liye ek study tool hai. Yeh policy batati hum kya lete, kaiku lete, kaun process karta aur aap kaisa mita sakte.
Privacy.s1Body: Aapka email aur password (jo hamara authentication provider sambhalta), aapki chuni zabaan, aapke banaye study workspaces, aapki upload ki files, unse nikala text, aapke banaye topic maps, aur service chalane aur mehfooz rakhne ke liye zaroori technical logs.
Privacy.s2Body: Sirf aapku GapFinder dene ke liye: aapka material rakhne, topic maps banane, quotes dikhane, aur service ku mehfooz aur fair-use limits mein rakhne ke liye. Hum aapka data nahi bechte, ads nahi dikhate, aur aapki files se AI models nahi sikhate.
Privacy.s3Body: Supabase aapka account, database records aur files rakhta. Groq aapke apne material ke chhote hisse topics suggest karne, purane paper padhne, jaanch ke sawaal likhne aur check karne, topics samjhaane aur quotes ka tarjuma karne ke liye process karta. ElevenLabs aapke bole hue sawaalon ko text mein badalta aur explanations padh ke sunaata; Cloudflare Workers AI aapke quote kiye sources ki baaton se tasveeraan banaata. Text embeddings hamare apne server pe bante. Har processor ko sirf utna milta jitna feature ko chahiye — aapka password kabhi nahi.
Privacy.s4Body: Aapke workspaces sirf aap dekh sakte. Files private rakhe jaate aur aise links se dikhte jo ek minute baad khatam ho jaate. Koi student doosre student ka workspace kabhi nahi dekh sakta.
Privacy.s5Body: Aapka data tab tak rehta jab tak aap mita nahi dete. Koi document mitaaye toh file aur usse bani har cheez mit jaati. Workspace mitaaye toh uske saare files, text, topics aur jude records mit jaate.
Privacy.s6Body: Aap kabhi bhi apni zabaan badal sakte, documents aur workspaces delete kar sakte, aur account menu se apna poora account delete kar sakte. Account delete turant hota: pehle aapki files, phir har record. Yeh policy kisi zaroori tareeqe se badli toh hum aapko naya version accept karne ko bolenge.
Privacy.s7Body: Privacy ke sawaal service ke saath diye contact details se bhej sakte.

PrivacyGate.title: Hamari Privacy Policy dekh lo

Explain.title: Yeh topic samjhao
Explain.subtitle: Jawaab sirf aapki apni kitaab ke chapter, notes aur syllabus se aate, un sahi quotes ke saath jin pe woh tike. Aapki files mein nahi hai toh hum saaf bolte.
Explain.placeholder: Jaise: resistance double hone pe current aadha kaiku hota?
Explain.groundedNote: Har jawaab dikhane se pehle aapki files se check hota.
Explain.transcribing: Aawaaz ko likhawat mein badal rahe…
Explain.micDenied: Microphone ki permission ruki hui hai. Browser mein allow karo, ya sawaal type karo.
Explain.recordingTooLong: Recording bahut lambi hai. Ek minute se kam rakho.
Explain.thinking: Aapke material mein jawaab dhoond rahe…
Explain.insufficientTitle: Aapke material mein abhi yeh nahi hai.
Explain.insufficientBody: Hum sirf wohi samjhaate jo aapki upload ki hui files mein hai, isliye andaaza nahi lagaate. Isko cover karne wale notes ya chapter upload karo, phir dobara poocho.

failures.PROVIDER_DAILY_LIMIT: Aaj ki AI limit poori ho gayi. Baad mein dobara koshish karo — agle kuch ghanton mein dheere dheere wapas milti.
failures.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: AI service busy hai. Ek minute baad dobara koshish karo.
failures.EXPLAIN_REJECTED: Jawaab aapki files se theek se nahi mila, isliye hata diya. Thoda aur saaf poocho.
failures.EXPLAIN_ERROR: Samjhaate waqt kuch gadbad hui. Dobara koshish karo.
failures.fallback: Kuch gadbad hui. Dobara koshish karo.
